bounty.title: [Security][Contract] Add a refund exit for partially funded split orders
bounty.body:
### Problem

A split order remains Funding until every listed co-buyer contributes. If A pays its 500-token share and B never pays, A cannot confirm, open a dispute, or obtain an administrative split refund. Normal order cancellation and expiry APIs use different storage keys. Funds have no withdrawal path through the current contract APIs.

### Priority and verification

**P1 — mainnet blocker.** An isolated test funded only one of two 500-token shares, advanced past ordinary order expiry, and confirmed that the order remained Funding and both dispute entry and administrative refund resolution rejected it.

Reviewed source: `25d942522b76e4252752249142326a757d3d78d6`. Mainnet readiness backlog; this report does not establish the configuration of any live deployment.

### Affected code

- [contracts/production_escrow/src/lib.rs:1261](https://github.com/Cylo-Traders/Agrocylo-Global/blob/25d942522b76e4252752249142326a757d3d78d6/contracts/production_escrow/src/lib.rs#L1261)
- [contracts/production_escrow/src/lib.rs:1383](https://github.com/Cylo-Traders/Agrocylo-Global/blob/25d942522b76e4252752249142326a757d3d78d6/contracts/production_escrow/src/lib.rs#L1383)
- [contracts/production_escrow/src/lib.rs:1420](https://github.com/Cylo-Traders/Agrocylo-Global/blob/25d942522b76e4252752249142326a757d3d78d6/contracts/production_escrow/src/lib.rs#L1420)

### Scope

Define and implement a funding deadline and/or authenticated cancellation policy for split orders. Return actual funded contributions and make the terminal/refunded state explicit. Document events, client-visible states, and pause behavior; do not activate an order after an exit leaves it underfunded.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A funded participant can recover its contribution when another co-buyer never funds, without requiring that missing participant's authorization.
- [ ] Unfunded addresses receive no refund, and duplicate cancellation/refund cannot pay twice.
- [ ] Partial exits cannot later produce an undercollateralized Active order or duplicate campaign revenue.
- [ ] Cover expiry boundaries, partial/full funding, absent participants, campaign failure/settlement, and the documented emergency-pause policy.

### Earlier work

Follow-up to #654 (closed). The evidence above describes the remaining gap at the reviewed commit, rather than asserting the earlier work made no improvements.

### Contributor notes

Keep the change focused, document any ABI/storage migration, and update relevant contract/deployment documentation. Validate with the targeted regression first and required repository checks before merge. This issue does not authorize mainnet deployment or assign a bounty.

**Automate open-source contribution cycles and rewards.**

Drips Wave is a platform designed to bridge the gap between open-source funding and daily maintenance work. This app integrates with your repository to run structured, short-term contribution cycles ("Waves") that accelerate development and reward contributors.

This GitHub App enables **Repo Maintainers** to sync their open-source repos to Drips Wave and **apply them to Wave Programs**.
